decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications:  PL1 (Rev 2), PL2 (Rev 2), PL3 (Rev 2), PL4 (Rev 2), PL5 (Rev 2), PL6 (Rev 2), PL7 (Rev 2), PL8 (Rev 2), PL9 (Rev 2), PL10 (Rev 2), PL11 (Rev 2), PL12 (Rev 2), PL13 (Rev 2), PL14 (Rev 2), PL15 (Rev 2), PL16 (Rev 2), PL17 (Rev 2), PL18 (Rev 2), PL19 (Rev 2), PL20 (Rev 2), PL21 (Rev 2), PL22 (Rev 2) Received: 01 May 2026;  PP-14778852v1 Received:  23 March 2026.

Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.

Reason: In order to safeguard the appearance of the area.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or openings shall be formed in the rear and side elevations, and roof, of the development hereby permitted.

Reason: In order to protect neighbours' privacy.

Condition : 5 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area.
Reason: In order to protect neighbours' privacy
description: Proposed erection of a rear roof extension to a dwellinghouse, including 2 no. of front conservation style roof lights, the height increase of the existing rear chimney stack, replacement of the existing rear ground-floor door and window with aluminium anthracite sash windows and door, alterations to the existing single-storey rear extension including removal of the parapet wall and reconfiguration of the rear corner
application_type_full: Householder planning & demolition in a conservation area
